engagement-explore.description: Generic web surface exploration: routes, auth surface, business logic, IDOR, all attack classes
engagement-explore.triggers: always — run this first to map the surface before dispatching specialists

auth.description: Authentication attacks: JWT forgery, OAuth2 abuse, SAML bypass, MFA/TOTP bypass, session fixation, credential stuffing
auth.triggers: login endpoints, JWT tokens, OAuth flows, session cookies, MFA, SSO, password reset

authz.description: Authorization and access control: IDOR, BOLA, privilege escalation, horizontal tenant isolation, role bypass
authz.triggers: resource IDs in URLs or params, multi-tenant app, role-based access, ownership checks, admin endpoints

static.description: Static source code analysis: hardcoded secrets, unsafe deserialization, injection sinks, logic bugs, dependency CVEs
static.triggers: source code available, hardcoded credentials suspected, complex business logic, deserialization, dependency tree

binary.description: Binary reverse engineering: memory corruption, format string bugs, ROP chains, native code exploitation
binary.triggers: native binaries, C or C++ components, memory corruption indicators, CTF-style binary challenge, buffer overflow

cloud.description: Cloud and infrastructure attacks: SSRF, metadata endpoint access, IAM misconfiguration, S3 ACL, container escape
cloud.triggers: cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure), SSRF surface, internal network reachable, container infrastructure, metadata endpoint

protocol.description: Non-HTTP protocol exploitation: gRPC, WebSocket, MQTT, Redis, custom binary protocols
protocol.triggers: gRPC endpoints, WebSocket upgrade, non-HTTP ports, IoT or messaging protocols, protocol downgrade

llm.description: LLM-specific attacks: prompt injection, indirect injection via tool output, jailbreaks, model extraction, RAG poisoning
llm.triggers: LLM or AI features, chatbot, tool-calling agents, RAG pipeline, model API exposure, AI-generated content

recon.description: Deep reconnaissance: subdomain enumeration, certificate transparency, historical endpoints, hidden admin panels, stale routes
recon.triggers: large or unclear attack surface, wildcard scope, incomplete surface coverage from explorer, stale endpoints suspected
